description: This file defines a PHP trait 'EndpointExceptionTrait' that provides methods for generating and throwing various exception types related to API endpoint error handling within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating specific exceptions and for validating entities and parameters.

methods.name: getBadRequestException
methods.description: Creates a BadRequestException with a default or custom message.

methods.name: getNotImplementedException
methods.description: Creates a NotImplementedException with a default or custom message.

methods.name: getRecordNotFoundException
methods.description: Creates a RecordNotFoundException with a default or custom message.

methods.name: getForbiddenException
methods.description: Creates a ForbiddenException with a default or custom message.

methods.name: throwRecordNotFoundExceptionIfNotExist
methods.description: Throws a RecordNotFoundException if the entity does not exist or is not of the specified class.

methods.name: throwRecordNotFoundExceptionIfEmptyIds
methods.description: Throws a RecordNotFoundException if the provided list of entity IDs is empty.

methods.name: getInvalidParamException
methods.description: Creates an InvalidParamException with error details for invalid parameters.
